title: Turbulence Fingerprint: code and derived data
description:
Code and derived data for the manuscript Higher-Order Intermittency in Learned Neural Motion Representations: A Testable Statistical Prediction.

The archive contains the four-dimensional optical-flow feature table for the 1,635-clip cross-generator evaluation set, the fixed five-fold assignment used in every experiment, per-clip scores for the foundation-model baseline and for the D3 detector, the reference outputs of the published run, and the scripts that regenerate the reported AUROCs.

No raw videos are redistributed; clip identifiers allow the tables to be matched against GenVideo and MSR-VTT under their own licences.
notes: Reviewed against the manuscript submission version. Replace the GitHub owner placeholder in CITATION.cff before the first release.
